scope: Read-only methods/citations audit for completed work. No new fit, preprocessing, checkpoint alteration or manuscript writing. All Q15 data and all prospective external cohorts excluded.

datasets.name: BNCI2014_001 / BCI Competition IV dataset 2a
datasets.role: Four-class development and same-dataset exploratory LOSO; binary source development for completed PhysioNet transfer
datasets.native_acquisition_reference: Left mastoid reference; right mastoid ground (official competition dataset description)
datasets.native_acquisition_filters: 0.5-100 Hz bandpass; enabled 50 Hz notch (official competition dataset description)
datasets.official_challenge_population_caveat: Original competition evaluation excluded expert-marked artifact trials. Project primary estimand deliberately retains every trial; it is not a literal reproduction of official competition scoring.

datasets.name: PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database v1.0.0
datasets.role: Completed Q14 independent binary external transfer, no target fitting
datasets.prediction_rows_explanation: Seven predictions per unique trial: two neural conditions times three fixed seeds, plus CSP4_LDA. Seeds are repeated measurements.
datasets.selected_eeg_channels: Same exact ordered 22 electrodes as BNCI audit

datasets.name: Munich High-Gamma / Schirrmeister2017
datasets.role: Background citation only; no executed empirical run or dataset configuration found in this repository
datasets.task_caveat: Executed left/right hand and feet movements plus rest; not the four-class left/right/feet/tongue motor-imagery task
datasets.manuscript_instruction: Do not include as an experimental dataset or report results; original CNN paper may be cited for architectural context.

common_bnci_preprocessing.filtering_unit: Each native recording run separately, before epoch extraction
common_bnci_preprocessing.primary_artifact_policy: include_all; source-only clean arm removes flagged source-training trials only

evaluation.outer_split: Nine subject-level LOSO folds; both sessions of target held out
evaluation.inner_split: Sort the eight source IDs, then four consecutive validation pairs; complement of six source subjects trains each inner fit
evaluation.learned_transform_scope: Refit transformations on exact inner-source-training partition; final transform uses only outer-source-training subjects
evaluation.Q5_epoch_rule: Earliest epoch minimizing equal-fold mean raw validation CE
evaluation.Q8_and_main_Q9_to_Q12_epoch_rule: Earliest epoch minimizing equal-fold mean within-fold validation-CE rank; average ranks for ties
evaluation.Q8_reuse: Uses original 36 Q5 inner trajectories; 27 new final fits only
evaluation.independent_units: Subjects, not seed fits, trials or source-subset fits
evaluation.primary_metric: Balanced accuracy per subject averaged over three seeds, then equal-subject mean
evaluation.same_dataset_inference_caveat: Research direction and later conditions were developed after prior BNCI target results; source-only inner selection does not make the full research program independently confirmatory.

eegnet.implementation: Braindecode 1.5.1 EEGNet; configured local implementation, not exact original-paper split/preprocessing replication
eegnet.architecture_description_caveat: Temporal and spatial learned filters provide a plausible inductive bias; no physiological source localization or rhythm-specific causal mechanism follows from architecture alone.

shared_mu_beta.input_shape: [batch,2,22,750] for four-class BNCI; [batch,2,22,480] for binary transfer
shared_mu_beta.parameters: One shared EEGNet, not two independent networks
shared_mu_beta.forward: Reshape band views into [2*batch,channels,times], one network forward; reshape output to [batch,2,classes], arithmetic mean of logits
shared_mu_beta.inference: Softmax applied after mean logits; this is not mean probabilities
shared_mu_beta.batchnorm_detail: Training BatchNorm is shared and updated from the concatenated mu and beta views; validation/inference eval mode freezes BatchNorm statistics. Dropout operates per view during training.
shared_mu_beta.parameter_count_vs_single_branch: Same 2,932 trainable parameters in four-class 22x750 model; two band views increase forward processing
shared_mu_beta.suggested_english: We applied fixed mu (8-13 Hz) and beta (13-30 Hz) filters and passed both views through the same EEGNet. The two class-logit vectors were averaged before cross-entropy during training and before softmax at inference. This constrains both bands to use the same network parameters without learning band-specific fusion weights.
shared_mu_beta.suggested_chinese: 固定μ/β频段提供两个输入视图，共用同一个EEGNet并等权平均logits；这是一种参数共享归纳偏置，尚不能证明生理特征解耦或因果机制。

completed_method_extensions.description: Broadband CSP8 and nine fixed 4-Hz bands from 4-40 Hz; per-band multiclass CSP8 with OAS; concat log-power features; StandardScaler + shrinkage LDA (lsqr, auto), linear SVM C=1, or source-fitted MI8 reduction
completed_method_extensions.caveat: An FBCSP-inspired approximation, not literal Ang2012 implementation; no hyperparameter search

completed_method_extensions.description: Welch PSD44 on Q8-filtered4-40Hz microvolt EEG; Hamming250samples,overlap125,nfft250,constant detrend,density scaling,mean windows; sum8<=f<13 and13<=f<=30 bins times delta-f, log10(power+1e-12); source-only StandardScaler and shrinkageLDA(lsqr,auto) or linearSVM(C=1)
completed_method_extensions.caveat: A fixed spectral-feature control; not Fourier artifact removal or learned feature selection

completed_method_extensions.description: MID8-30 and shared-mu-beta retrained at already frozen Q8 source-selected per-target epoch numbers; three fixed seeds; no representation-specific inner reselection
completed_method_extensions.caveat: Fixed-duration representation sensitivity, not duration-optimal comparison

completed_method_extensions.description: Per-channel source-fitted z-score; separately per-band in Q9-E005; same moments applied unchanged to validation/target
completed_method_extensions.caveat: No target distribution statistics; normalized input dimensionless

completed_method_extensions.description: Drop artifact-flagged source-training trials only; held-out validation and target identities preserved
Source-only eight CSP or covariance-PCA projections per band; concatenate 16 projected channels; source-only projected-channel standardization; 16x750 EEGNet
completed_method_extensions.caveat: CSP/PCA width matched with each other, not with shared-band22-channel EEGNet; effects do not isolate spatial projection alone

completed_method_extensions.description: Fixed per-trial shrinkage covariance, matrix-log feature vector with Frobenius weighting; outer source-only shallow classifiers
completed_method_extensions.caveat: Log-Euclidean geometry features; no target-pooled alignment and not affine-invariant tangent-space adaptation

completed_method_extensions.description: Four-band shared (8-12,12-16,16-22,22-30), two-band independent, two-band44-channel early stack, and broadband capacity comparator
completed_method_extensions.caveat: Capacity chosen only from model structure; 0.853% mismatch remains; sharing also changes BatchNorm/representation coupling

completed_method_extensions.description: Source equal-subject pooled covariance whitening with5% mean-eigenvalue ridge and scale preservation; matched balanced ERM vs GroupDRO
completed_method_extensions.group_dro_update: Log weights +=0.05*detached per-source group CE, normalize logsumexp; weighted group loss; persistent weights across epochs
completed_method_extensions.caveat: Source whitening is not He/Wu target EA. Balanced ERM controls group sampling and update budget; GroupDRO vs pooled ERM conflates both.

completed_method_extensions.description: Train-only channel dropout p=.1 (survivor scale1/.9), gain U[.8,1.2], and gain then dropout; no validation/target augmentation
Raw source-CE, mean-rank and fixed20 duration sensitivity; Q5 raw CE originally reused, Q9 raw CE recalculated from archived source-only curves
completed_method_extensions.caveat: Historical Q5 run has different runtime; use matched-runtime Q13-E006 for preferred fixed20 duration contrast

completed_method_extensions.description: At fixed20 epochs, k=2,4,6 circular source-ID subsets starting0,2,4,6 among sorted eight sources; both methods, four identity subsets, three seeds. k=8 uses fixed20 anchor. Source trial counts576*k
completed_method_extensions.caveat: Natural minibatches-per-epoch confound source count with optimizer updates; not isolated causal subject-count effect

completed_method_extensions.description: Eight source subjects, only source session0train or1test (2304 training trials); fixed20 epochs; both target sessions retained
completed_method_extensions.caveat: One vs both-source-session comparison also changes training examples and update counts

completed_method_extensions.description: 27 matched-runtime final broadband fits using archived Q5 raw-CE-selected duration; no new inner fit
completed_method_extensions.caveat: Tests historical schedule in Q13 runtime, does not prove new runtime inner reselection would choose same schedule

binary_external_method.source_resampling: SciPy resample_poly16/25 after native250Hz run-filtering and epoching
binary_external_method.external_filtering: Native160 or128Hz run-local fourth-order zero-phase IIR, same Hz bands, epoch cue-relative[.5,3.5), no baseline/re-reference/artifact rejection
binary_external_method.external_resampling: S88,S92,S100: native128Hz384-sample epoch, then resample_poly5/4→480; others native160Hz480 samples
binary_external_method.source_duration_rule: Equal-inner-fold mean within-fold validation CE ranks, earliest minimum
binary_external_method.csp4_lda: MNE CSP4 reg=None log=True cov_est=concat norm_trace=False full rank mutual_info order; StandardScaler; LDA solver=svd. Different CSP/LDA regularization from Q4 comparator.
binary_external_method.runtime_caveat: Independent V1 reconstruction used a different host/runtime; historical and validation receipts retained.
binary_external_method.task_comparison_caveat: Binary external BA and four-class BNCI BA have different class chance levels; do not numerically combine them into one task score.
